text:
Ivar Stenberg went second overall in June, and less than two months into his NHL life he's riding with Macklin Celebrini and Will Smith. Sharks Hockey Digest's Max Miller wrote on Nov. 16 that the line "has dominated," and the three combined for 8 points in the 4-2 win over Nashville, where Stenberg had a goal and an assist.

His 14 points in 24 games come at 0.58 a game, right on the median for forwards picked first to fourth since 2005 in their first real season. Eight of them came on the power play. His 7 goals are almost exactly what his chances were worth, so there's no shooting bubble here, and his ice time has climbed to nearly 18 minutes over the last ten games.

The work in progress is defense: San Jose gets under 45% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, though he still rates slightly better than his teammates. Our talent range puts his scoring right at league average for a forward, which at 19 is the headline. Miller later posted that Collin Graf was out with Celebrini and Stenberg while Smith sat, so watch whether the line stays together.
headline: Stenberg has found a home with Celebrini
